headline: Tussle, from entry to detail
overview: Tussle is a practice tool for working through attachment-related conflicts. Based on attachment theory, it presents realistic relationship conflict scenarios and guides you through resolving them in ways that build secure connection rather than triggering defensive patterns. It helps you recognize your attachment responses in the heat of conflict and practice more regulated, connected responses.
targetAudience: Users interested in relationships tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Realistic relationship conflict scenarios grounded in attachment theory
Practice choosing responses that build security rather than triggering defensiveness
Recognition of your personal attachment patterns in conflict situations
Guided reflection on how your responses align with secure attachment goals
tips: Notice your gut reaction to each scenario before selecting a response — that reaction reveals your attachment style
Practice regularly; behavioral patterns in conflict change slowly but surely with consistent rehearsal
